reason: I've already cycled through and abandoned Calm and journaling apps, and I just don't believe an AI chatbot simulating empathy can actually support me when I'm overwhelmed by work deadlines. It feels like a robotic substitute rather than genuine care.
objection: AI can't replace a real human therapist who actually cares.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of clinically verified stress reduction or a hybrid model connected to real human therapists.
